statement.notes: The 'depreciation_and_amortization' field was mapped directly from the single line item 'Depreciation, amortization, and other' found in the 'Adjustments to reconcile net income to net cash from operations' section of the Consolidated Cash Flow Statement. No other elements from the statement or supplementary tables were required to make up this total. The scale is 1E6 (millions) as indicated in the statement header. The currency is USD based on the use of the dollar symbol ($).
